event_summary: A tan rod extending from a round black object moves toward a right-side set of upright blocks, and the three right-side blocks tip down while the four left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: At the start, seven narrow rectangular blocks stand upright on a wooden tabletop in two separated groups: four blocks on the left and three blocks on the right. A round black cylindrical object sits behind and to the right of the right-side group, with a green top piece and a tan rod visible near it. The tan rod changes orientation and extends leftward from the round object toward the rightmost black block. The rightmost black block in the right-side group leaves its upright position, followed by the white block and the other black block in that group also moving to down or tilted positions on the tabletop. The four blocks in the left-side group remain upright. The round black object stays in place, and the camera view remains steady.

reasons: The upright blocks, tabletop, round black object, green top piece, and tan rod area are visible before the block motion begins.
The right-side blocks are still upright in the first frame.
